attributes.title: Honeypot - how to investigate
attributes.visState:
{"title": "Honeypot - how to investigate", "type": "markdown", "aggs": [], "params": {"fontSize": 11, "openLinksInNewTab": false, "markdown": "**How to investigate** · data arrives about 1-2 minutes after the attack (pull every 60 s)

1. **Pivot:** click any value in a table (IP, password, command, hash) and choose *Filter for value*; every panel follows. Remove the filter pill to go back.
2. **One intrusion, start to end:** expand a row in *live attacker events*, then filter on its `cowrie.session`. You see connect, login, every command and every download in order.
3. **Malware:** `cowrie.shasum` is the file Cowrie captured on the honeypot. Look up the **hash** only (e.g. on VirusTotal); never download the file.
4. **Alerts:** Security > Detections shows what the 3 honeypot rules raised from this data.

**All values here are attacker data:** never run a command or open a URL shown on this dashboard."}}
